description: 3SGX is a high performance PCIe cryptograhic module that provides complete cryptographic support to large numbers of users or applications simultaneously. 3SGX is the core of 3S Group's hardare security appliances, ideal for enterprise key management, virtualization and cloud server solutions that demand high throughput.

capabilities: Hash Algorithm: SHA-1, SHA2-224, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512
